_note: Hand-picked landmark laws and Supreme Court cases for /timeline ("Who Held Power When It Happened?"), read and joined by lib/timeline-data.ts. Laws with a `law_id` take their signing date, veto override and party vote split from pipeline/output (laws.json, law_votes/); a `date` on one is a check that must agree. Laws without one (before 1973, or not in laws.json) carry their own `date`. Cases with a `case_id` take their vote and each justice's vote from decisions_cases.json and court/justice_votes.json; a `date` on one overrides SCDB's date. Cases decided before the SCDB data starts (1946) carry a hand-entered `hand_vote` (the vote and the dissenters' last names), and the 1964 and 1965 civil-rights laws carry a hand-typed `hand_split` (yes and no votes by party per chamber, from the record; to verify against Voteview): both are marked as typed in by hand on the page. `wiki` is the English Wikipedia article title, each checked to exist (redirects followed) through the MediaWiki API on 2026-10-16.

extra_justices.why: Left the Court before the Martin-Quinn data (and so court/justices.json) starts in October 1937; needed for the 1933-37 Court and the 1937 dissents.

events.name: Emergency Banking Act
events.what: Reopened sound banks after the national bank holiday and let the Treasury back them.

events.name: Emergency Conservation Work Act (CCC)
events.what: Created the Civilian Conservation Corps, which put young men to work on forests, parks and flood control.

events.name: Agricultural Adjustment Act
events.what: Paid farmers to cut production to raise crop prices.

events.name: Federal Emergency Relief Act
events.what: Gave states federal grants for direct relief to the unemployed.

events.name: Tennessee Valley Authority Act
events.what: Created the TVA to build dams and bring power to the Tennessee Valley.

events.name: Securities Act of 1933
events.what: Required companies to register securities and disclose their finances before selling stock.

events.name: Home Owners' Loan Act
events.what: Created the Home Owners' Loan Corporation to refinance mortgages in default.

events.name: National Industrial Recovery Act
events.what: Set industry codes on wages, prices and hours and funded public works.

events.name: Banking Act of 1933 (Glass–Steagall)
events.what: Separated commercial and investment banking and created the FDIC.

events.name: Gold Reserve Act
events.what: Moved the nation's gold to the Treasury and revalued the dollar.

events.name: Securities Exchange Act of 1934
events.what: Created the SEC to regulate stock exchanges and trading.

events.name: Reciprocal Trade Agreements Act
events.what: Let the president negotiate tariff cuts with other countries.

events.name: Indian Reorganization Act
events.what: Ended the division of tribal land and restored a measure of tribal self-government.

events.name: Emergency Relief Appropriation Act
events.what: Funded the Works Progress Administration and other work-relief programmes.

events.name: Schechter Poultry v. United States
events.what: Struck down the National Industrial Recovery Act, the centre of the early New Deal.
events.wiki: A.L.A. Schechter Poultry Corp. v. United States

events.name: National Labor Relations Act
events.what: Guaranteed workers the right to organise and bargain collectively.

events.name: Social Security Act
events.what: Created old-age pensions and unemployment insurance.

events.name: United States v. Butler
events.what: Struck down the Agricultural Adjustment Act's farm processing tax.

events.name: Rural Electrification Act
events.what: Funded loans to bring electricity to farms and rural areas.

events.name: West Coast Hotel v. Parrish
events.what: Upheld a state minimum wage, the turn after which the Court stopped striking down New Deal laws.
events.wiki: West Coast Hotel Co. v. Parrish

events.name: NLRB v. Jones & Laughlin Steel
events.what: Upheld the Wagner Act and Congress's power to regulate labour relations.
events.wiki: NLRB v. Jones & Laughlin Steel Corp.

events.name: Housing Act of 1937
events.what: Created the U.S. Housing Authority to fund public housing.

events.name: Fair Labor Standards Act
events.what: Set a federal minimum wage and the 40-hour week, and limited child labour.

events.name: Selective Training and Service Act
events.what: Set up the first peacetime draft in U.S. history.
events.wiki: Selective Training and Service Act of 1940

events.name: Lend-Lease Act
events.what: Let the U.S. lend or lease war supplies to Britain and other Allies.

events.name: Wickard v. Filburn
events.what: Read the Commerce Clause to reach wheat a farmer grew for his own use.

events.name: Servicemen's Readjustment Act (GI Bill)
events.what: Paid for veterans' college, home loans and unemployment benefits.

events.name: Korematsu v. United States
events.what: Upheld the wartime exclusion of Japanese Americans from the West Coast.

events.name: Labor Management Relations Act (Taft–Hartley)
events.what: Restricted union practices; passed over President Truman's veto.

events.name: Housing Act of 1949
events.what: Funded slum clearance and public housing.

events.name: Youngstown Sheet & Tube v. Sawyer
events.what: Blocked President Truman's seizure of the steel mills.
events.wiki: Youngstown Sheet & Tube Co. v. Sawyer

events.name: Brown v. Board of Education
events.what: Ruled racially segregated public schools unconstitutional.

events.name: Federal-Aid Highway Act
events.what: Funded the Interstate Highway System.

events.name: Civil Rights Act of 1957
events.what: The first civil rights law since Reconstruction; created the Civil Rights Commission.

events.name: Baker v. Carr
events.what: Let federal courts hear challenges to how legislative districts are drawn.

events.name: Gideon v. Wainwright
events.what: Required states to provide a lawyer to defendants who cannot afford one.

events.name: New York Times v. Sullivan
events.what: Set the actual-malice standard for libel suits by public officials.
events.wiki: New York Times Co. v. Sullivan

events.name: Civil Rights Act of 1964
events.what: Banned discrimination in public accommodations and employment.

events.name: Heart of Atlanta Motel v. United States
events.what: Upheld the Civil Rights Act's ban on discrimination in public accommodations.
events.wiki: Heart of Atlanta Motel, Inc. v. United States

events.name: Social Security Amendments of 1965
events.what: Created Medicare and Medicaid.

events.name: Voting Rights Act
events.what: Banned discriminatory voting practices and required federal preclearance in some states.

events.name: Immigration and Nationality Act of 1965
events.what: Ended national-origin quotas in immigration.

events.name: Miranda v. Arizona
events.what: Required police to warn suspects of their rights before questioning.

events.name: Loving v. Virginia
events.what: Struck down state bans on interracial marriage.

events.name: Fair Housing Act
events.what: Banned discrimination in the sale and rental of housing.

events.name: Occupational Safety and Health Act
events.what: Created OSHA and federal workplace safety standards.
events.wiki: Occupational Safety and Health Act (United States)

events.name: Clean Air Act Amendments of 1970
events.what: Set national air-quality standards and limits on pollution.

events.name: Education Amendments of 1972 (Title IX)
events.what: Banned sex discrimination in federally funded education.

events.name: Clean Water Act
events.what: Regulated pollution discharges into U.S. waters; passed over President Nixon's veto.

events.name: Roe v. Wade
events.what: Recognised a constitutional right to abortion.

events.name: War Powers Resolution
events.what: Limited the president's power to commit troops without Congress; passed over Nixon's veto.

events.name: Endangered Species Act
events.what: Protected threatened and endangered species and their habitats.

events.name: United States v. Nixon
events.what: Ordered President Nixon to hand over the White House tapes.

events.name: Gregg v. Georgia
events.what: Allowed the death penalty to resume under revised state laws.

events.name: Regents of the University of California v. Bakke
events.what: Struck down racial quotas in admissions but allowed race as one factor.
events.wiki: Regents of the University of California v. Bakke

events.name: Department of Education Organization Act
events.what: Created the Department of Education.

events.name: Economic Recovery Tax Act of 1981
events.what: Cut income tax rates across the board.

events.name: Social Security Amendments of 1983
events.what: Raised payroll taxes and the retirement age to keep Social Security solvent.

events.name: Tax Reform Act of 1986
events.what: Lowered rates and closed loopholes in a broad rewrite of the tax code.

events.name: Immigration Reform and Control Act
events.what: Gave legal status to about 3 million immigrants and penalised employers who hire unauthorised workers.
events.wiki: Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986

events.name: Americans with Disabilities Act
events.what: Banned discrimination against people with disabilities.

events.name: Clean Air Act Amendments of 1990
events.what: Added a cap-and-trade programme for acid rain and tightened air standards.

events.name: Planned Parenthood v. Casey
events.what: Kept Roe's core holding and replaced its framework with the undue-burden test.

events.name: Family and Medical Leave Act
events.what: Guaranteed unpaid, job-protected leave for family and medical reasons.
events.wiki: Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993

events.name: Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1993
events.what: Raised top income tax rates and cut spending to reduce the deficit.

events.name: NAFTA Implementation Act
events.what: Put the North American Free Trade Agreement into effect.

events.name: Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act
events.what: Funded police and prisons and banned some assault weapons for ten years.
events.wiki: Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act

events.name: Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Act
events.what: Replaced federal welfare entitlements with block grants and work requirements.
events.wiki: Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996

events.name: Defense of Marriage Act
events.what: Defined marriage as between a man and a woman for federal purposes.

events.name: Bush v. Gore
events.what: Stopped the Florida recount in the 2000 presidential election.

events.name: Economic Growth and Tax Relief Reconciliation Act
events.what: Cut income tax rates and phased out the estate tax.
events.wiki: Economic Growth and Tax Relief Reconciliation Act of 2001

events.name: USA PATRIOT Act
events.what: Expanded government surveillance powers after the September 11 attacks.

events.name: No Child Left Behind Act
events.what: Required annual testing and tied school funding to results.

events.name: Lawrence v. Texas
events.what: Struck down state laws criminalising same-sex intimacy.

events.name: Medicare Prescription Drug Act
events.what: Added a prescription drug benefit (Part D) to Medicare.
events.wiki: Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act

events.name: District of Columbia v. Heller
events.what: Recognised an individual right to keep a handgun at home.

events.name: Emergency Economic Stabilization Act
events.what: Created the $700 billion Troubled Asset Relief Program for banks.

events.name: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act
events.what: An $800 billion stimulus of spending and tax cuts during the recession.
events.wiki: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009

events.name: Citizens United v. FEC
events.what: Struck down limits on independent political spending by corporations and unions.

events.name: Affordable Care Act
events.what: Expanded health coverage through marketplaces, subsidies and Medicaid.

events.name: Dodd–Frank Act
events.what: Tightened financial regulation and created the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau.

events.name: Don't Ask, Don't Tell Repeal Act
events.what: Let gay, lesbian and bisexual people serve openly in the military.
events.wiki: Don't Ask, Don't Tell Repeal Act of 2010

events.name: NFIB v. Sebelius
events.what: Upheld the Affordable Care Act's individual mandate as a tax.
events.wiki: National Federation of Independent Business v. Sebelius

events.name: Shelby County v. Holder
events.what: Struck down the Voting Rights Act's formula for which states needed preclearance.

events.name: Obergefell v. Hodges
events.what: Recognised a constitutional right to same-sex marriage.

events.name: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
events.what: Cut the corporate tax rate to 21% and lowered individual rates through 2025.

events.name: CARES Act
events.what: A $2.2 trillion pandemic relief package.

events.name: Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act
events.what: Funded roads, bridges, broadband and transit.

events.name: Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health
events.what: Overturned Roe and Casey, returning abortion law to the states.
events.wiki: Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization

events.name: CHIPS and Science Act
events.what: Subsidised U.S. semiconductor manufacturing and research.

events.name: Inflation Reduction Act
events.what: Funded clean energy and let Medicare negotiate some drug prices.

events.name: Respect for Marriage Act
events.what: Required federal and state recognition of same-sex and interracial marriages.

events.name: Students for Fair Admissions v. Harvard
events.what: Ended race-conscious admissions at colleges and universities.
events.wiki: Students for Fair Admissions v. Harvard

events.name: Loper Bright v. Raimondo
events.what: Overruled Chevron deference to agencies' readings of statutes.

events.name: Trump v. United States
events.what: Gave former presidents immunity for official acts.

events.name: Trump v. CASA
events.what: Limited universal injunctions issued by lower courts.

events.name: One Big Beautiful Bill Act
events.what: Extended the 2017 tax cuts and cut Medicaid and food-aid spending.
